1.mascotDialogue: Nothing clever here — compare your neighbour, swap if you are larger, and repeat the sweep until nothing requires swapping. Alors, simple.

2.mascotDialogue: `n minus i minus 1` on line 3 shrinks the inner loop's range with every pass — the last i elements are already sorted, no need to keep checking them.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar creep one step to the right with every swap it loses — this is the 'bubbling' the algorithm is named for, made entirely literal.

4.mascotDialogue: This one will not crash every time — it will simply, occasionally, read rubbish past the array. Exactly the sort of bug that goes unnoticed, since it does not always announce itself.
